bundle std::prelude::Stream

    pub bundle Stream<T: type>

The standard valid/ready handshake. A beat transfers in every cycle in which
both `valid` and `ready` are high. Once a producer raises `valid` it keeps
`valid` high and `data` stable until the beat transfers; `valid` must never
depend combinationally on `ready` (`ready` may depend on `valid`).

Generics:
  T  type

Fields:
  valid       bool  The producer offers `data` this cycle.
  data        T     The payload. Meaningless while `valid` is low.
  flip ready  bool  The consumer accepts a beat this cycle. Flows against the
                    bundle.

Methods:
  fn fire() -> bool
      True in a cycle in which a beat transfers (`valid and ready`).

Tested behaviours:
  * stream fire needs valid and ready
